newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to release 150 bln won thru repo.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to release 150 bln won thru repo.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea said on Monday it would supply 150 billion won to the banking system through a repurchase agreement (Repo) maturing on Tuesday.

A central bank official said the bank decided to release the money to help domestic banks meet a twice-monthly deadline to meet won reserve requirements by the Bank of Korea. The deadline is on Monday.
The Bank of Korea plans to invite tenders for the repo at 0630 GMT.
